text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! What a nostalgic photo! Fuji-san 
really is super cool!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, I saw Fuji Kiseki and 
Jungle Pocket happily looking at old 
photos together.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, weren't you the one who looked cool? 
That was the moment I started to respect 
you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you curious? Well then, let's put 
on an impromptu recitation drama—!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—My first impression? Let's see... "A kid 
brimming with endless energy."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You're Fuji Kiseki, aren't you!? Ooooh, 
amazing! It's the real deal~~!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I... not yours... wait, no! I enrolled 
here after watching Fuji-san race!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, little pony. If I was able to 
show you a dream as well, then I am glad.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm aiming to be the "strongest" too! 
Looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Juniors
text_block_list.text:
"Kyaaaaah! Fuji-senpai~~!" "What's that? 
Practicing for the Fan Appreciation 
Festival?" "Amazing~, I heard she's 
running in the relay!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Alright...! Everyone's gotten completely 
used to passing the baton now!

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Junior A
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Fuji-senpai is our anchor this year, 
so we might actually win this~!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The crowd's going wild! That's Fuji-san 
for ya. I'll definitely be there to cheer 
you on in the main event!

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Kyaah! I'm cheering for you too!" "Me 
too~~! Do your best!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, my little ponies! I will claim 
victory without fail and show you the 
finest of dreams! Now, back to practice we 
go.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Damn. That's so cool. That composure... 
or honestly, everything about her is just 
so strong."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Because you're strong, you can show 
everyone a dream!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Back then, I hadn't realized it yet. That 
Pokke wasn't just a girl full of energy...

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Kyaah~♡ Fuji-sama~~~~~!!" "You looked 
wonderful playing futsal, too!" "Aah, next 
up is the main event: the relay race!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Junior A
text_block_list.text: Huh? Fuji-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, it's nothing. Come on, let's hurry 
up and get ready for the relay!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Fuji-san... Did you hurt something 
just now?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hm? Why is that?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I totally get it! I've been watching 
Fuji-san's running this whole time!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
………… I'm sorry, but could you keep quiet 
about this? Just until this relay is over.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What if it gets worse? I've got 
another race coming up!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I can't withdraw from the race. We 
don't have any substitutes, after all.”

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Something like that... I'll take care of 
it!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. Still, I can't let a student 
who just enrolled overexert herself.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You're the one being reckless! If this 
keeps you from racing, your fans are gonna 
cry even harder, damn it!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Let me do it. I'm gonna become the 
strongest. Something like this is nothing 
to me.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The dream you wanted to show everyone... 
please, entrust it to me, Fuji-san!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Pokke...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Post time was closing in. That's why I 
had to ask Pokke.

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
“—Here is an announcement. Due to mild 
discomfort detected in her leg, Fuji 
Kiseki will withdraw from the relay race 
as a precaution.”

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, how pitiable!" "It's unfortunate, but 
I hope she takes care of herself." "Races 
come first, after all... Oh, it's 
starting!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOAAAAAHHHHHーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Fans
text_block_list.text:
"My, what a reckless running style...!" 
"Still, doesn't it feel a little like 
Master Fuji's...?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Pokke... Kh...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaah--!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Jungle Pocket surges from behind and 
crosses the finish line!! Overcoming every 
hardship, Team Fuji Kiseki claims a 
magnificent victory!!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah! How was that!? Fuji-san!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah... Now this is a surprise...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha...! Man, what an incredible 
girl... Seriously.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—...And just like that, Pocket brought the 
whole house down!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh! That brings back memories. 
Hearing Fuji-san tell the story makes it 
feel like it just happened yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that scene really left a strong 
impression on me. Because entrusting 
something to someone else was something I 
had never even considered.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, maybe so. Pocket just has to, 
doesn't she!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The venue erupted into a storm of 
applause. Saying, 'She carried on their 
hopes and dreams.' ...You know?
